notes.title: Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone
We have a very exciting news, Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure 2 is now available on steam!

Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure 2 is an Action-RPG that builds upon its predecessor with 30 playable dinosaurs, numerous unlockable skins, customizable RPG elements, and a variety of regions to explore. At its core, Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure 2 is geared for players who prefer a more casual and lean back experience.

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
With the release of Dinosaurs A Prehistoric Adventure 2, we would also like to address what's next for us in terms of development.

As we all know, the multiplayer survival genre for dinosaur games in particular is getting extremely crowded. And although we do see the appeal, we strive to make something different and unique without disregarding player interest. Because of this we have decided to work on smaller projects so that we may test the waters as to what may or may not work in order to better allocate our resources. Currently, we have another small project that is currently in the works and we will share more details about this when its more fleshed out.

Thank you so much for your support, and more updates coming soon.

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ArcupionArt]Twitter[/url] and subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2sxw-fdSdQei9ZKFIBzrsQ]Youtube[/url] channel to not miss out on any information regarding development.
